{{Quote|Oh, for the days when I could rip apart a tonitran with my beak!|[[Arankau]]|<ref name="beast hunt">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=daily|The Great Beast Hunt|[[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]}}</ref>}}
'''Tonitran''' lizards, known in the mount trade as '''Marsh Raptors''',<ref name="cartel">{{TORcite|type=other|[[Cartel Market]]}}</ref> were a large [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]]<ref name="codex" /> species, native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="Shadow of Revan" /> Juvenile tonitran lizards were known as '''coppi''' lizards.<ref name="makeb" />
[[File:RegulatorsTonitran-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|[[InterStellar Regulators|ExRegulators]] hunting Tonitran lizards]]
While native to the jungles of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], tonitrans were also found on [[Makeb]], where [[InterStellar Regulators|ex-regulators]] hunted them for sport.<ref name="makeb">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>

==Description==
Tonitrans stood on two legs and had four clawed digits on each limb.<ref name="tonitrans" /> They had a keen eyesight and an insatiable appetite. Regarded a feared predator, they relied on muscular hind legs to gain purchase with their powerful claws and propel themselves at great speed, often resulting in a successful kill before their prey could react. The substantial tail of a tonitran not only assisted in its balance, but also provided excellent defense against any creature attacking from behind.<ref name="codex" />

Wild tonitrans had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin with a green pattern on their back. [[Bone/Legends|Osseous]] bumps formed a line on their backs and their bellies, while two distinct fangs stood upwards from their maws.<ref name="tonitrans">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=enemy|Jungle Tonitran|[[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]}}</ref>

==Mount Trade==
Tonitran lizards were trainable and were used for riding. Several breeds of Tonitran mounts were sold during the wars between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], including the common "Marsh Raptor", as well as a silver with a red and black pattern ''Bloodthirsty Raptor'', dark green ''Forest Raptor'' and ''Terrorclaw Raptor'', whose skin had a mixed pattern of yellow, grey, red and black.<ref name="cartel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tonitrans first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as unnamed creatures on the planet [[Makeb]], but it wasn't until the following expansion, [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']], when the creature was established and added to the bestiary codex of the planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].
